What's new in 2.24.0

Three new tools — share secrets with an agent safely, fill forms from your own context, and fan a whole dev setup across your screen — plus a fix for notched Macs.

New: Secrets ⌃⌥V

  • Hand an API key to a coding agent without ever pasting it into the chat. Store the secret once (it lives in your Keychain), and Dax gives you a one-line dax run --secret … to hand the agent. When it needs the value, the local broker asks you to approve, then injects it into just that one command — never printed, never in the conversation.

New: Context Fill ⌃⌥X

  • Filling out a form? Snip the question, get a paste-ready answer. Build a Context Pack once — résumé, docs, links — then snip any question on screen and Dax answers it from your own information. Snip several and it answers each.
  • It adapts. No exact match? It makes a sensible, labelled guess instead of a blank. Refine any answer with a follow-up, and edit-and-remember folds your correction back into the pack so it's right next time. Press E mid-snip to switch packs.

New: Fanout ⌃⌥D

  • One profile, a whole dev setup. Add the repos you work on together, hit ⌃⌥D, and Dax opens a terminal in each with your agent running — tiled side by side. Works with Terminal and iTerm2, with per-repo command overrides, YOLO, and optional folder-trust skip.

Notch-friendly

  • Menu-bar icon hidden behind the notch? New Show icon in the Dock option in Settings → General gives you a notch-proof way in, and a one-time tip points the way. You can always summon Dax with ⌃⌥Space.

Polish

  • Image to URL: press ⇥ on the result to switch between copying the link and the image, with a longer window to decide.
  • Frequent CLIs: press ⇥ to switch between typing a command and opening it in a fresh terminal (in a folder you choose); optional skip of Claude's folder-trust prompt on YOLO launches.
  • Generate Image: press ⌘⇧S to snip a region of your screen straight into the prompt.
  • Boilerplates: share a template as a single .daxel file — double-click to install it.
  • Signed, notarized, universal (Apple Silicon & Intel), macOS 14+.
